scope: Complete standalone fixture inputs and stdout/stderr controls. Candidate libvvp is reproducible with the pinned archive and build_private_queue_observer.py; the shared library is not bundled.
observerBoundary: Caller must hold the simulator thread or coroutine mutex. No serialization of event payloads, executing callbacks, thread internals or freed storage. The fault-control API is invoked only by the explicit corruption fixture, which restores its mutation before returning to the scheduler.
integration: Not connected to the live board state observer yet. Existing long captures continue using the original libvvp.
